BiblicalUsage: To scatter, or puff away, appears once, in the song of Moses: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men, were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe scattering is the judgment God held back: He said He would scatter Israel into corners, and then He remembered mercy.
